aliasing.description: places record the writes the effect analysis observes, with its escape decision, and each address taken as a raw place; reads and arguments have no places, and a slice, map or pointer that two bindings share isn't tracked

constant-values.description: literal values only; constant expressions and iota are not evaluated

dispatch.description: interface method calls stay dynamic; implementations are not selected

evaluation-order.description: the CFG follows Go's specified order, except that a select's channels and values are evaluated in the arm that runs them rather than on entry

exceptional-flow.description: panic and calls known never to return have edges; a panic from a callee or the runtime, recover, and the deferred calls that run on the way out do not

generic-instances.description: instances are not recorded; a call through a type parameter is a dependent reference

implicit-calls.description: Go has no destructors, implicit conversions that run code, or overloaded dereferences

integer-semantics.description: widths and signedness come from go/types; signed and unsigned overflow wrap

macro-provenance.description: Go has no macros; header statements and implicit switch alternatives carry desugaring provenance

mutability.description: a binding is immutable when nothing replaces it, takes its address or writes part of its own value; named results stay mutable, since a return writes them; package variables are definitions of kind other, because core reads a static as a constant and each use of a mutable static as a global effect

resolution.description: go/types resolves references; a function outside the typed build overrides this as unknown

types.description: every typed node refers to a structured type; named types omit their members, and channels and complex numbers are opaque

ast.description: every statement and expression; constructs without a neutral kind are registered go: extensions

cfg.description: edges between the nodes of a function's own body; a closure's body has none, since it runs when called, and a deferred call stays at its defer statement

evidence.description: coverage per document, with an override per function

method.description: identity, spans, parameters, receiver, results and generics

place.description: writes from the effect analysis, with their field, index and dereference steps; which element an index writes isn't tracked

ref.description: identifiers and calls; a call through a function value that is not a local name is unresolved

symbol.description: locals, parameters, receivers and named results, with an access per reference

type.description: structured types from go/types; named types omit their members

unit.description: packages, files with content, imports and referenced definitions
